title: Early Screening of Colorectal Precancerous Lesions Based on Combined Measurement of Multiple Serum Tumor Markers Using Artificial Neural Network Analysis
summary: ANN CA6 combines six measured serum tumor markers; Methods describes cohort and model construction. Results reports AUC 0.97 overall, 0.97 precancerous, 0.93 early CRC; retrospective cohort.
